{{Conjecture|legends}}
Following the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[Bevel Lemelisk]], went into hiding at a remote '''retreat''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hefi]], fearing for his life for having failed the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] eventually discovered Lemelisk's retreat and took him into custody.
